floater.name: wolf_drive_controls
floater.title: Driving Controls

button.label: Joystick Configuration...
button.name: joystick_btn
button.tool_tip: Choose and enable the controller (Firestorm's Joystick Configuration)

check_box.label: Drive with this controller whenever I sit on anything (it then stops moving the avatar and the flycam)
check_box.name: use_hardware

check_box.label: Also move my avatar with it when I am not seated (Joystick Configuration's Avatar mode)
check_box.name: avatar_mode

combo_box.name: steer_axis
combo_box.tool_tip: Which axis of the controller is the steering

check_box.name: steer_invert
check_box.tool_tip: Tick if the steering works the wrong way round

progress_bar.name: steer_bar
progress_bar.tool_tip: What the viewer reads from the steering now

button.label: Detect
button.name: steer_detect
button.tool_tip: Press, then move the steering: the axis is picked for you

combo_box.name: throttle_axis
combo_box.tool_tip: Which axis of the controller is the accelerator

check_box.name: throttle_invert
check_box.tool_tip: Tick if the accelerator works the wrong way round

check_box.name: throttle_full
check_box.tool_tip: Tick if the pedal rests at one end of its axis (reads -1 released). Untick if it rests in the middle (0).

progress_bar.name: throttle_bar
progress_bar.tool_tip: What the viewer reads from the accelerator now

button.label: Detect
button.name: throttle_detect
button.tool_tip: Press, then move the accelerator: the axis is picked for you

combo_box.name: brake_axis
combo_box.tool_tip: Which axis of the controller is the brake

check_box.name: brake_invert
check_box.tool_tip: Tick if the brake works the wrong way round

check_box.name: brake_full
check_box.tool_tip: Tick if the pedal rests at one end of its axis (reads -1 released). Untick if it rests in the middle (0).

progress_bar.name: brake_bar
progress_bar.tool_tip: What the viewer reads from the brake now

button.label: Detect
button.name: brake_detect
button.tool_tip: Press, then move the brake: the axis is picked for you

combo_box.name: clutch_axis
combo_box.tool_tip: Which axis of the controller is the clutch (optional)

check_box.name: clutch_invert
check_box.tool_tip: Tick if the clutch (optional) works the wrong way round

check_box.name: clutch_full
check_box.tool_tip: Tick if the pedal rests at one end of its axis (reads -1 released). Untick if it rests in the middle (0).

progress_bar.name: clutch_bar
progress_bar.tool_tip: What the viewer reads from the clutch (optional) now

button.label: Detect
button.name: clutch_detect
button.tool_tip: Press, then move the clutch (optional): the axis is picked for you

check_box.label: Combined pedals: one axis, accelerator one way from the middle and brake the other (the brake row is then not used)
check_box.name: combined

slider.label: Dead zone
slider.name: dead_zone
slider.tool_tip: How far the wheel turns, or a pedal moves, before it counts. Raise it if the vehicle creeps or turns by itself.

text.name: gear_up_key
text.tool_tip: The key that does this (on its own, no Shift / Ctrl / Alt)

button.label: Set key
button.name: gear_up_setkey

line_editor.name: gear_up_ch

floater.text: Horn with nothing set (Sends: Nothing) plays the built-in horn - car, truck, bike or speedboat, by the dashboard's design (none for the spaceship or submarine) - in-world on Wolf Territories, for everyone near to hear.
Pick each control, or press Detect beside it and move that control.
Seated, the controller sends the same keys as the keyboard, so every vehicle works with it. It also sends the exact wheel and pedal positions to scripts that read wolfDriveInput.
